scheme_name: Scheme Of Assistance To Disabled Persons For Purchase/Fitting Of Aids/Appliances
other_conditions: Holder of a 40% disability certificate (benchmark disability)
Monthly income from all sources not exceeding Rs.30,000 (or parents/guardians income not exceeding Rs.30,000 for dependents)
No assistance received for the same purpose in the last three years (one year for children below 12 years)
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for purchase and fitting of aids/appliances, covering full cost for items up to Rs.15,000 and up to 50% for higher‑cost items, with additional travel and lodging allowances.
